phase_2_groq_model_regression_investigat.root_cause_analysis: The previous certification report erroneously claimed 'openai/gpt-oss-20b' was invalid and replaced it with 'llama-3.3-70b-versatile'. In reality, 'llama-3.3-70b-versatile' is retired/unavailable for this account tier, returning HTTP 404. Setting it as default broke Groq, triggering silent failover to Gemini. The tester observed Gemini's response and incorrectly attributed it to Groq. Furthermore, the non-Gemini model name crashed Gemini until a defensive string check was patched.
phase_2_groq_model_regression_investigat.recommendation: Revert PROVIDER_DEFAULTS['groq'] to 'openai/gpt-oss-20b' (or 'openai/gpt-oss-120b'). Remove invalid model overrides.

finding_a_backend_dependency.name: Backend Dependency Failure (psutil)
finding_a_backend_dependency.reproduction: pip install -r backend/requirements.txt in a clean container; python server.py fails at line 153 with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'psutil'.
finding_a_backend_dependency.root_cause: psutil import introduced in commit d96411d without adding psutil to backend/requirements.txt.
finding_a_backend_dependency.remaining_risk: Immediate crash of backend service on any fresh deployment or container build.

finding_b_image_engine_status.name: Image Engine Status Method Signature (missing self)
finding_b_image_engine_status.reproduction: python -c "from local_image_engine import local_image_engine; local_image_engine.get_status()" raises TypeError: OmniLocalImageEngine.get_status() takes 0 positional arguments but 1 was given. GET /api/ai/image/engine/status returns HTTP 500.
finding_b_image_engine_status.root_cause: Method declared as def get_status() -> Dict[str, Any] inside class instead of def get_status(self).
finding_b_image_engine_status.remaining_risk: Image Gen UI throws unhandled network failure / CORS error upon loading in frontend.

finding_c_auth_security.name: Authentication Security (Hardcoded Dev Secret & Insecure Demo Account)
finding_c_auth_security.reproduction: Starting backend without JWT_SECRET in production uses hardcoded default 'omniverseos-dev-do-not-use-in-prod'. Anyone can forge arbitrary user/admin JWT tokens. Furthermore, lines 77-88 automatically seed demo@omniverse.io with known password 'omniverse123'.
finding_c_auth_security.root_cause: Fallback to insecure string when JWT_SECRET environment variable is missing; automatic demo user seeding in production lifespan.
finding_c_auth_security.remaining_risk: Complete authentication bypass and unauthorized account takeover in production.

finding_d_cors_security.name: CORS Wildcard with Credentials
finding_d_cors_security.reproduction: When CORS_ORIGINS is '*', app sets allow_origin_regex='.*' and allow_credentials=True, reflecting any Origin header.
finding_d_cors_security.root_cause: Attempt to bypass browser credential blocking by using regex wildcard.
finding_d_cors_security.remaining_risk: Any origin can issue authenticated API calls if ambient credentials or credentials forwarding are ever used.

finding_e_database_persistence.name: Silent In-Memory Fallback to mongomock_motor
finding_e_database_persistence.reproduction: If MongoDB on port 27017 is unreachable, _is_mongo_online() returns False, and the database silently falls back to mongomock_motor.AsyncMongoMockClient() without raising an error or logging a warning.
finding_e_database_persistence.root_cause: Permissive silent fallback in database initialization.
finding_e_database_persistence.remaining_risk: User accounts, chat sessions, notes, tasks silently stored in volatile RAM; total data loss on container/process restart.

phase_9_definitive_launch_decision.executive_summary: OmniverseOS 2.0 cannot be certified for public beta release today. While the desktop shell, animations, Jest suite (82 tests), and Pytest suite (23 tests) demonstrate substantial engineering work, multiple critical defects directly block production readiness: a missing backend dependency (psutil) will crash fresh deployments; a broken method signature crashes the Image Gen API; Groq is configured with an inaccessible model that causes silent 404 fallbacks; silent mongomock_motor fallback poses an acute data-loss risk; and dev JWT secrets threaten total authentication compromise. Furthermore, previous audit claims of '142 working controls' and '18 live AI tasks' were traced to synthetic test generation scripts and hardcoded mock strings. The release is on HOLD until these blockers are resolved and committed.
